output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
df <- fread("output/master_unified_intelligence.csv")
total_n <- nrow(df)
immutable_pct <- round(sum(df$hta_verdict == "IMMUTABLE TRUTH") / total_n * 100, 1)
fragile_n <- sum(df$hta_verdict == "FRAGILE")
avg_dci <- round(mean(df$dci_score), 1)
```

## Abstract
We present the HTA Unified Intelligence System (UIS), currently auditing **`r total_n`** medical technologies. Our living audit reveals that only **`r immutable_pct`%** of technologies achieve the "Immutable Truth" status.

## 1. Results
Of the **`r total_n`** technologies audited, **`r fragile_n`** reside in the "Fragile" tier. The average Data Completeness Index (DCI) across the portfolio is **`r avg_dci`%**, indicating high reliance on evidence synthesis engines.

## 2. Conclusion
The UIS framework allows healthcare systems to move beyond static appraisal. As new data enters the ecosystem, these statistics update in real-time, providing a "Living" evidence synthesis platform.
